name: Conspiracy
source: After having a weird dream where a voice says that they're leaving your messed up wishes in your hands, the following day you get confessed by the two most popular “Princes” at your school; cool student council president Katsuo Shirokawa and basketball ace player Yuu Kuromori. Of course, you could easily reject them, but you end up being good friends with both and start developing feelings. Just when the three of you finally get along well, you receive a love letter and that’s when things get complicated.
